run_lm_finetuning_main: run the python module to fine-tune GPT, GPT-2, BERT, or RoBERTa models for language modeling
create_TextDataset: create a TextDataset class that tokenizes text files into fixed-size blocks with caching support
run_train: run the train function to fine-tune a language model with optional gradient accumulation and distributed training
run_evaluate: run the evaluate function to compute perplexity on an evaluation dataset
run_mask_tokens: run the mask_tokens function to prepare masked tokens for masked language modeling training
